text.text: CPU: Toshiba TLCS900H core (16-bit) @ 6.144 MHz | Memory: 12 KB RAM for 900/H, 4 KB RAM for Z80, 64 KB ROM | Sound: T6W28 (enhanced SN76489 with 3 square-wave tone generators + 1 noise generator, stereo capability), dual 6-bit digital-to-analog converters. Sound system controlled by a Z80 processor @ 3.072 MHz. | Video: 160×152 | Color: 146 (or 20 in monochrome mode) on-screen out of 4096 |
